1) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine of less than __2000 Da__ and a polyanion, said nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron, __wherein the polyalkylenimine is polyethylenimine and the polyanion is sodium polyvinyl sulfonate__.

2) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle intimately associated with a multivalent cation crosslinker, __wherein the multivalent cation crosslinker is selected from the group consisting of zirconium acetate, sodium zirconium lactate, and zirconium sulfate__.

3) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyalkylenimine is __selected from the group consisting of polyethylenimine and polypropylenimine__.

4) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyanion is selected from sodium polyvinyl sulfonate, poly (sodium acrylate), poly(sodium styrene sulfonate), copolymers of sodium acrylate with sodium vinylsulfonate or sodium styrene sulfonate; dextran sulfate, and __other anionic surfactants__.

5) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 2, wherein said multivalent cation crosslinker is a complexed zirconium compound selected from the group consisting of zirconium acetate, sodium zirconium lactate, zirconium sulfate, __and zirconium tetrachloride__.

6) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, further comprising monovalent or divalent cations selected from the group consisting of sodium, potassium, magnesium __, calcium, or aluminum ions__.

8) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex comprises a nanoparticle with an average particle size of about __100 to 900 nm__ in diameter.

12) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 10, said nanoparticle entrapping a multivalent cation __selected from the group consisting of zirconium, chromium, titanium, iron, or aluminum__.

20) (Currently Amended) A delayed gelling composition comprising: a) a delayed gelling agent comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyethylenimine of less than 2000 Da and a polyvinyl sulfonate intimately associated with a multivalent metal cation crosslinker, said nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron; b) a polymer having anionic sites that can be crosslinked with said metal cation crosslinker; and c) a fluid, __wherein the multivalent metal cation crosslinker is selected from the group consisting of zirconium and aluminum__.

21) (Currently Amended) A delayed gelling composition comprising: a) a composition of claim 1; b) a polymer __that can be crosslinked with said composition__; and c) a fluid. 

24) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is a polymer or copolymers of acrylate, acrylamide, N,N-dimethylacrylamide, tert-butyl acrylate, acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonic acid, or sodium 2-acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonate, or N,N-dimethylacrylamide. 

26) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where fluid is __selected from the group consisting of brine, seawater, or freshwater__.
